tips.item1: Say which part fails: seat, cable, screen, weights…
tips.item2: Mention when it happens — always, or only under load.
tips.item3: One report per machine keeps things easy to track.
tips.safety: If the machine is unsafe, stop using it and tell a staff member right away.
